paragraphs: Hello! I am Ben. Today our class makes a book. It is an animal book. I like animals a lot. Teacher Kim writes three words on the board. They are dog, donkey, and duck. Do you want to make a book too? Get three papers and a pen.

One, put the papers on the table. Two, draw a dog on page one. Three, draw a donkey on page two. Four, draw a duck on page three. Five, look at the board. Six, write a word under a picture. Write, "A dog can run." Write, "A donkey has long ears." Write, "A duck can swim."

Now show your book to the class. My dog is brown. My donkey is gray. My duck is yellow. Leo likes my duck. May likes my dog. "Good book, Ben!" says Teacher Kim. "Can you read it to us?" I read my book to the class. Now I want a long book!
text.summary: Ben shows how his class makes an animal book. You draw a dog, a donkey, and a duck, and then you write one fact for each.
